prompt: Create an original 150 second Celtic acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for exercise, action montage and energetic motion. Mood: energetic, driving, determined. Instruments: fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp. Style: lilting compound-meter dance and modal melody. Tempo approximately 124 BPM; B minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use strong rhythmic articulation and maintain momentum from the first bar. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A lively and melancholic instrumental piece featuring a prominent accordion melody, supported by pizzicato strings, a walking bassline, and light percussion. It evokes a traditional European folk or waltz style, with a nostalgic and romantic feel. The arrangement is clean and well-balanced.
description.zh: 一首活泼而略带忧郁的器乐作品，以突出的手风琴旋律为主，辅以拨弦乐器、行进的低音线和轻快的打击乐。它唤起了一种传统的欧洲民间或华尔兹风格，带有一丝怀旧和浪漫的情调。编曲清晰且平衡。
